skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine the least common denominator (LCD) of two fractions and convert each to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with common denominator
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions with the same denominator, keeping the denominator unchanged.

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Operate with mixed numbers
skills.definition: Separate a mixed number into its whole part and fraction part, subtract whole parts, handle borrowing when the fraction part is insufficient (decrease the whole number by 1 and add the denominator to the numerator of the fraction part, repeating if necessary), and combine the whole and fraction results; also includes rewriting a whole number as a mixed number with a given denominator when needed.

skills.name: Mixed number whole part operations
skills.definition: Interpret mixed numbers and whole numbers as whole parts and fraction parts, subtract whole parts, and combine the results into a mixed number or integer.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator of two fractions and rewrite them as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions with a common denominator, keeping the denominator unchanged.

skills.name: Borrowing
skills.definition: Borrow 1 from the whole part when fraction subtraction yields a negative result, by increasing the numerator by the denominator and reducing the whole part by 1, then perform the subtraction.

skills.name: Simplification
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Find common denominator and convert fractions
skills.definition: Identify the least common denominator of two fractions and convert each fraction to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with common denominator
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that have the same denominator, keeping the denominator unchanged.

skills.name: Handle mixed numbers and whole numbers
skills.definition: Interpret mixed numbers and whole numbers as a sum of a whole part and a fractional part, rewrite whole numbers as mixed numbers with appropriate denominator when needed, and subtract the whole parts.

skills.name: Borrow from whole part
skills.definition: When the fractional part of the result is negative, decrease the whole part by 1, add the denominator as a fraction to the fractional part, and then subtract the original fraction.

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with like denominators
skills.definition: Directly subtract the numerators while keeping the common denominator when two fractions have the same denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with unlike denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator, convert both fractions to equivalent fractions, then subtract the numerators.

skills.name: Subtract whole numbers
skills.definition: Subtract the integer parts of mixed numbers or whole numbers involved in the subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Borrow from whole number
skills.definition: When the fraction subtraction yields a negative result, take one unit from the whole number and add it as a fraction with the common denominator to the fraction part, then subtract again.

skills.name: Convert whole number to mixed number
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number as a mixed number with a given denominator (e.g., 3 = 3 + 0/d) to allow subtraction of a fraction or mixed number.

skills.name: Convert to common denominator
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator of two fractions and convert them to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract whole numbers
skills.definition: Subtract the whole number parts of mixed numbers or whole numbers.

skills.name: Subtract fractions
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of fractions with the same denominator, keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Borrow/regroup
skills.definition: When the fraction part of the minuend is less than the fraction part of the subtrahend, borrow 1 from the whole number part, add the denominator to the fraction, and then subtract.

skills.name: Simplify fraction
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.
